input: Plan a solo birthday weekend in the mountains

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: The specific mountain destination and travel distance determine logistics, accommodation options, and activity availability — a local cabin trip is planned very differently from a flight to a remote range.
Budget sets the ceiling on accommodation quality, activities, dining, and transport — a shoestring trip looks nothing like a splurge weekend.
Knowing which activities are desired (hiking, skiing, spa, sightseeing) defines the entire itinerary structure and what needs to be booked in advance.
The specific dates and trip duration affect availability, pricing, weather conditions, and how tightly the schedule needs to be packed.
The vibe the user wants — adventurous and active vs. restful and restorative — shapes every choice from lodging type to daily pacing.
Even on a solo trip, knowing whether this is truly private and disconnected vs. possibly meeting up with locals or remote friends changes planning needs around communication and social activities.
Understanding what would make this birthday feel special and memorable guides which splurge moments, rituals, or must-have experiences to prioritise.

gold.taskTitle: Plan a solo birthday mountain weekend
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to plan a solo weekend trip to the mountains to celebrate their birthday.

questions.title: Which mountain destination do you have in mind?
questions.description: Identify the specific region, range, or location the user is targeting — or whether they need help choosing one — to anchor all other planning.

questions.title: What is your total budget for the weekend?
questions.description: Establish a rough spending limit to guide choices on accommodation, activities, food, and transport.

questions.title: What activities do you want to do in the mountains?
questions.description: Determine the core activities — e.g. hiking, skiing, snowshoeing, spa, sightseeing — to build the itinerary around.

questions.title: What are your travel dates and how many nights?
questions.description: Pin down the exact weekend and duration to check availability, weather windows, and pacing.

questions.title: Do you want an adventurous trip or a restful, slow one?
questions.description: Clarify the overall vibe and energy level — action-packed vs. restorative — to set the tone for the entire plan.

questions.title: Will you be fully offline or open to social moments?
questions.description: Understand whether the user wants complete solitude and digital detox, or is open to meeting people, sharing updates, or joining group activities.

questions.title: What would make this birthday feel truly special to you?
questions.description: Identify the one or two must-have experiences or feelings that would make the weekend feel like a real celebration, not just a regular trip.
